material.learn: A downtrend's first crack: a close over its latest lower high.

material.head: Sitting on support
material.text: Price sits on the buy zone.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Next support −4.2% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −4.2% below (1.3 ATR), where 8 levels (3 kinds) meet: the 200-week average, the June breakout level and the 38.2% retracement of the Sep 24–Nov 4 rise.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.
